implementation_gate: B2 has passed. B3 formal SCR sampling may begin only after candidate build-b3 identity, exact generated run.in/model.xyz hashes, GPUMD identity and release RNG binary evidence, analysis/test code hashes, and reference checkout states are frozen; short controls and route/negative gates must pass first.

units.time: fs; Tdamp and tau_p inputs are step counts

statistics.description: Stable periodic NEP diamond, 3x3x3 conventional cells, 216 atoms; lattice and coordinates both scaled from a=3.57 angstrom by 1.0023 for the B0 near-zero-pressure reference state.
statistics.initial_velocity: Independent explicit Gaussian components; Python random.Random(seed).gauss; mass=12.011; kB=8.617343e-5 eV/K; velocity conversion=10.18051; no COM removal or constraints.

ber_golden_small.description: Same near-zero periodic diamond and explicit-velocity generation as statistics fixture, 216 atoms; 200-step Ber golden.

ber_golden_large.description: Periodic diamond 7x6x6, 2016 atoms, same 1.0023 scale and explicit velocity seeds; one 200-step Ber case to exercise new cache invalidation at larger size.

compressed.description: Near-zero diamond reference state compressed isotropically by 0.5%; registered by B0 to raise mean diagonal pressure about +6.49 GPa.

expanded.description: Near-zero diamond reference state expanded isotropically by 0.5%; registered by B0 to lower mean diagonal pressure about -6.25 GPa.

m2a_eligible.description: Existing 18x6x6 periodic diamond, 5184 atoms; use only to prove explicit M2a-eligible NPT request remains routed to M1, not for statistical sampling.

negative-nonperiodic.description: 216-atom diamond changed to pbc T T F for explicit NPT unsupported-box rejection.

negative-triclinic.description: 216-atom diamond with xy tilt 0.1 angstrom for explicit nonorthogonal NPT rejection.

zero-ke.description: Two noninteracting stationary carbon atoms in a 30 angstrom periodic cube; exercises zero kinetic energy guard without force or periodic-contact ambiguity.

pressure_direction.assertion: Assert first deterministic box response direction, not monotonic instantaneous pressure relaxation.

b2_berendsen.golden_acceptance: Compare GPUMD thermo temperature, six stress columns, box columns and XYZ positions/velocities at registered frames with pre-existing golden tolerance; report exact max error by file/column/frame and first out-of-tolerance item. Do not update existing golden or tolerance.
b2_berendsen.restart_contract: Separately classify one long run, same-process split run and file restart at T1=T2; record first divergence and precision. Assert restart Lattice/positions are post-scale and thermo stress is pre-scale. Do not presume trajectory continuity.

b3_scr_statistics.reference_rng_source: std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() in release initialize_rng; verify pinned executable disassembly calls system_clock::now
b3_scr_statistics.reference_job_launch_policy: one process at a time; distinct recorded UTC start seconds are conservative isolation only and do not observe internal seed
b3_scr_statistics.burn_in: Discard first 10% of each fixed budget prefix, independently at each preregistered look.

statistics.temperature_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference must be within 2% of 300 K; compare with the registered CI. Also report each engine's absolute offset from 300 K separately. Canonical K variance oracle is Var(K)=3N*(kB*T)^2/2 for 3N unconstrained momentum degrees of freedom. Temperature is reported using product's 3N definition; do not invent an instantaneous target-temperature variance.
statistics.pressure_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference CI must lie within +/-0.1 GPa using independent-seed estimates; also report each engine's offset from Ptarget separately.
statistics.volume_mean: Candidate-vs-GPUMD mean difference CI must lie within +/-0.25% of the GPUMD reference mean; report each engine's mean and absolute target-theory diagnostics separately.
statistics.variance: For T, P and V compare candidate/reference variance ratios; allowed interval [0.85,1.15].
statistics.distribution: For T, P, V report empirical CDF sup-distance and 5th/50th/95th quantiles. V CDF sup-distance must be <=0.15 as an auxiliary equivalence criterion; provide block/seed uncertainty intervals and normalized quantile differences. Do not report an iid KS p-value.
statistics.reference_comparison: Run GPUMD SCR release as independent jobs with identical explicit model.xyz/run.in/potential bytes; pinned release initialize_rng uses std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() (binary branch verified by nm/objdump). Serialize launches with distinct UTC start seconds as conservative isolation and record UTC start/end, PID, and source+binary RNG evidence; this does not observe or prove distinct internal seeds. Never compare stochastic trajectories or reuse a GPUMD random stream. Candidate deterministic seed is explicitly DMGMD_ENSEMBLE_SEED=101..108.
statistics.same_condition_gate: All registered candidate-vs-GPUMD equivalence CIs must lie entirely within their fixed bounds, and block/ESS criteria must pass. A common target-theory deviation is separately reported as THEORY_TARGET_INCONCLUSIVE and does not negate same-condition compatibility; do not claim universal strict sampling or ergodicity.
statistics.confidence: Use existing sample_statistics.py Geyer initial-positive paired autocorrelation, block and between-chain Student-t intervals, taking the wider interval; three planned looks use z=2.394. Coverage is per registered metric/look family as implemented, not a joint 95% guarantee over the complete matrix. Equivalence passes only when the full CI lies within the bound; a precise disjoint CI fails; insufficient precision is INCONCLUSIVE.
statistics.no_posthoc_changes: Do not change seeds, burn-in, budgets, thresholds, fixture, statistical method, or add looks after seeing formal results. Preserve all failures and inconclusive results.

formula_fixture.gaussian_source: Fixed registered scalar(s), injected directly into pure host formula fixture; never use GPUMD release RNG or production RNG for this test.
assertions: zero-noise branch when B_GPa>2000 per compatibility rule

independent_physics.EOS_control_parameter: 425 GPa is only the input barostat control modulus.
independent_physics.separate_response_evidence: Measure a static pressure-volume EOS slope on the same NEP potential/diamond around the chosen state; report fitted range, slope, uncertainty and input hashes independently of control B.
independent_physics.independent_NPT_oracle: If candidate and GPUMD agree but disagree with independently verified target theory, preserve both results and classify theory check INCONCLUSIVE; use LAMMPS or a solvable independent sampler only if needed to diagnose a reproducible discrepancy.

b4_route_and_negative_matrix.npt_forces_m1: Every NPT request prints mode=m1 reason=npt-m1-only; directly entering M2a NPT path fails closed.

short_smoke.restart: Write and launch a separate restart job; assert post-scale box/position consistency, no trajectory continuity claim for SCR.

negative_cases: 12-token and 18-token anisotropic syntax rejected with explicit v1-isotropic-only diagnostic
non-finite or invalid T/B/tau_p rejected before dynamics
B_GPa>2000 accepted and fixed-box branch verified
nonorthogonal or nonperiodic M1 box rejected
NPT with correct_velocity, adaptive timestep or experimental DMGMD_DOMAIN/overlap options rejected unless explicitly covered
invalid seed syntax/rank disagreement and nonpositive/nonfinite scale fail collectively without MPI hang
M2a-eligible NEP input still routes M1; direct local-domain NPT entry rejected
b4_route_and_negative_matrix.negative_test_requirements: Use timeout; collect all-rank exit/error evidence; assert no successful final thermo/trajectory/restart artifact after preflight failures.

budget.candidate_and_reference_maximum: For each engine, 8 seeds * (80000 base steps + 160000 half-dt steps) = 1,920,000 system steps; 3,840,000 total engine-steps over both engines, each at 216 atoms.
budget.staged_execution: At each look analyze fixed prefixes for all eight seeds. Candidate longer budgets are complete deterministic reruns from the same initial state and fixed candidate seed; verify prior prefix outputs byte-for-byte before reusing earlier looks. Never resume from restart or stitch segments. GPUMD reference uses one single-segment maximum-budget run per seed, shared by registered conditions and prefix looks. No same-second reference launches.
budget.ber_and_route: 200-step GPUMD Ber golden at 216 atoms plus one 2016-atom case; 20-step route/restart smoke at P1/P2/P4 and enabled backends; 5184 atoms only for M2a eligibility routing.

input_locking.input_generator: Reproduce the deterministic conventional diamond basis and Python random.Random(seed).gauss procedure used by tests/thermostats/run_thermostats.py::model_text; apply scale 1.0023 to both lattice and coordinates; use 1+scaled fractional Cartesian coordinates and .17g serialization. Verify each generated model hash against fixture map above before running.
remaining_hashes_to_finalize_before_any_: exact B2 input hashes emitted by generator; verify against fixture maps above
input_locking.statistics_xyz_policy: No trajectory.xyz/dump_xyz during SCR statistics. Per-step thermo.out records T/P/V; only sparse restart/output diagnostics are run as separate B2/B4 tests.
